reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Cilium CLI: Upgrade Cilium CLI to v0.15.0 or later to switch to Helm installation mode to install and manage Cilium v1.16", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Classic mode installations are not supported with Cilium v1.16 and are not compatible with Helm mode; they must be uninstalled with the classic mode CLI and re-installed with Cilium CLI v0.15.0 or later in Helm mode.
consequence.remediation: Uninstall Cilium using classic mode Cilium CLI, then re-install using Cilium CLI v0.15.0 or later in Helm mode.

proposed.statement: Cilium v1.16 is not supported in Cilium CLI classic installation mode; classic-mode installations must be uninstalled with the classic CLI and re-installed using Cilium CLI v0.15.0+ in Helm mode.
